CITY OF FITCHBURG 
 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING 
 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
LEGISLATIVE AFFAIRS COMMITTEE MEETING 
MINUTES 
 
 
 
F I T C H B U R G C I T Y C L E R K 
 
 
 
MEETING DATE: Tuesday, September 15, 2026 
 
MEETING TIME: 6:00 PM 
 
MEETING PLACE: LEGISLATIVE BUILDING 
 
MEETING ADDRESS: 700 Main Street, Fitchburg, MA 
Chair Walsh, Cruz, Starr, Van Hazinga & 
COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Zarrella 
    
All members were present for the meeting. Health Department Director Steve Curry attended and introduced 
the petition. 
 
AGENDA ITEMS: * 
 
This meeting will be open to the public. 
 
The meeting began at 6:01pm 
*Council as a Whole Meeting 
 
Agenda Items: * 
 
Approval of the following Minutes: September 2, 2026 
 
150-26.           Stephen D. Curry, Director of Public Health, requests that the City Council repeal Chapter 
164 of the City Ordinances, Sales of Tobacco Products as outlined in the enclosed petition. 
 
Director Curry explained that Chapter 164 of the City Ordinances was adopted in 1992 and it had not been 
updated since. He explained that the ordinance was fairly limited, that the Board of Health regulations were 
more detailed, that changes occur in the field of tobacco products frequently, and that is a cleaner and more 
efficient process to delete chapter 164 from the ordinances and allow the Board of Health to maintain 
regulations regarding the sales of tobacco products. 
 
The Committee agreed and approved the petition 5-0.   
 
 
*This notice is provided in the event that a quorum of the City Council is present at this standing committee meeting, 
thereby constituting a Committee of the Whole. If fewer than a quorum of the City Council is present, no Committee 
of the Whole meeting shall be convened. If a quorum is present, the Committee of the Whole shall be limited strictly 
to the standing committee agenda items listed above. 
 
The meeting was adjourned at approximately 6:07pm 
 
 
Beth Walsh, Chair, Legislative Affairs Committee
